    LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.s225_perm

    BO13a §2.2.5, first step: contours of long entries are reflecting #

    MulBasis.s225_perm: in a minimal crown (every long morphism in a contour), if ρ₁ factors through the first arrow of one path of a contour of a long σ₁ and ρₙ through the last arrow of the other path, then replacing σ₁, ρ₁ by v₂, ρ₁' gives a crown of the same length and smaller weight (BO13a figure 9.1; Lemma 8 gives the peak ρ₁', σ₂).
